phase1_abstract_interpretation.summary: Prysm is a consensus layer (beacon node) client implemented in Go. It does not implement EVM execution, EVM precompiles, or gas calculation of any kind. The ModExp gas formula (EIP-7883) is exclusively an execution layer concern implemented in execution clients such as go-ethereum, Nethermind, and Besu. A comprehensive search of the entire Prysm repository (3011 Go files) using tree-sitter MCP and text search found zero occurrences of 'modexp', 'ModExp', 'BigModExp', 'eip7883', 'EIP-7883', or any precompile gas calculation logic. The property under audit — whether the division by 3 from the pre-EIP-7883 formula is absent — has no applicable code surface in this target.

Prysm receives execution payloads from the EL client via the Engine API; it does not re-execute transactions, call precompiles, or compute gas costs. There is no function, method, or package in the Prysm codebase where a /3 division in a ModExp gas formula could exist. No counterexample can be constructed because there is no relevant code to analyze.

There is no entry point in Prysm through which an attacker could influence ModExp gas formula selection.

phase3_invariant_proving.summary: The invariant 'no division by 3 in ModExp gas formula' is vacuously satisfied in Prysm: no ModExp gas formula exists. The property cannot be violated in this target.
